name: Damon Baird — campagne Gears of War 2006
source_game: Gears of War (2006) — capture promotionnelle de prépublication
variant: Baird campagne originale — référence promotionnelle juin 2006
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE static transparent full-body 2D game costume candidate.
Primary request: Damon Baird in his campaign armor from the ORIGINAL 2006 Gears of War, costume id baird_skin_02.
Reference role: This is an official Epic/Microsoft promotional group screenshot accompanying a June 2006 interview with Cliff Bleszinski. BAIRD is the BLOND man at the FAR LEFT of the image, wearing blue goggles on his forehead, with a rifle raised vertically beside his right shoulder. Cole, Marcus and Dom are the three other men to the right: do not include them or borrow their faces/outfits. Reproduce only that leftmost Baird, not his Ultimate Edition redesign or older Gears 4/5 look. The source shows him from head to boots.
Preserve Baird's young adult fair rugged face with light stubble, short spiky blond hair, thick dark-framed blue goggles pushed onto his forehead, stout muscular Gears proportions and the worn very dark gray-green original COG armor. Faithfully keep the thick chest/abdominal plate shapes, rounded shoulder/chest fittings with small cool blue lights, bulky side utility pouches, dark worn trousers, thigh straps and plates, broad armored knees, heavy shin guards and thick-soled armored boots visible in the source. Avoid inventing decals, logos, extra colored trim or decorative parts. Match the subdued grimy 2006 palette and original silhouette. The small details are to follow the visible reference, not modern remaster armor. Do not copy Marcus's bandana or Cole's skin or Dom's face.
Change the pose only: set the rifle aside and give Baird two empty hands in a calm static combat guard, knees slightly bent, arms separated from torso. Predominantly SIDE VIEW with a small front three-quarter angle, looking and pointing toes to screen RIGHT. No attack, violence or particles.
Rendering: crisp realistic hand-painted 2D game cutout, neutral even light for readable armor relief.
Composition: exactly one complete figure from hair to both boot soles, no cropping, body uses only 75% of image height with at least 10% transparent padding on all sides.
Background: actual transparent alpha, opaque character, clean antialiased edges. No scene, floor, ground shadow, haze, halo, gradient, backplate, text, watermark, second person, turnaround, sprite sheet or animation.

sources.scope: Entretien de Cliff Bleszinski du 16 juin 2006, images créditées Epic/Microsoft. La légende identifie de gauche à droite Baird, Cole, Marcus et Dom. Baird est visible en pied à gauche ; capture prépublication 1024 × 576, détails sombres et bras partiellement masqué. Il ne s'agit pas d'Ultimate Edition.
Rendu complet de développement lié à Ultimate Edition, examiné puis exclu. Ne confirme pas le corps exact du modèle de campagne 2006 et n'a pas été transmis au générateur.

observations: Référence promotionnelle authentique de la période originale 2006 retrouvée en pied ; elle permet de distinguer le costume d'Ultimate Edition, mais ne certifie pas chaque détail du modèle final.
Les images de comparaison Ultimate Edition ont été inspectées puis exclues afin d'éviter le mélange d'éditions.
Une seule tentative avec la capture de 2006 : refus au stade sortie, aucun PNG reçu et aucun réessai.
